next.reason: 1985: "level-number [data-name-1/FILLER] [REDEFINES data-name-2] [PICTURE...] ... [BLANK WHEN ZERO] [VALUE IS literal-1]."; 2023: "[ IS TYPEDEF [ STRONG ] ] [ ALIGNED ] [ ANY LENGTH ] [ BASED ] ... [ IS EXTERNAL [ AS literal-1 ] ] [ IS GLOBAL ]". All 1985 clauses and formats 2/3 are carried, and the name was already optional (brackets) in 1985. 2023 adds many clauses (TYPEDEF, BASED, EXTERNAL, etc.), so more entries are accepted.
